leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a functional component that accepts props and renders content
Apply React.memo to wrap a functional component for performance optimization
Construct a parent component that passes props to a memoized child component
Configure props comparison logic for React.memo when default shallow comparison is insufficient
Update state in a parent component to trigger re-renders and observe memoization effects
Bind event handlers in components to test re-render behavior with and without memoization
Control component re-renders by manipulating props passed to memoized components
